description.value: A third-generation family-run campground on Brannen Lake with 130+ forested sites and a private beach, just minutes from Nanaimo's services — a practical lakeside base with a suburban-park feel rather than a wilderness retreat.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active campground with 130+ forested sites on Brannen Lake near Nanaimo, family-owned since 1985. Reservations are clearly accepted via their online form with credit card. The website mentions being 'a few minutes to all amenities Nanaimo has to offer,' supporting Food nearby. The rules page mentions electric connections (RV hookups) and firewood for sale at the office, but no specific mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, laundry, cyclist discounts, or other cycling-specific amenities. Contact info on the website (phone, address) corroborates and supplements OSM data.
concerns: Website footer copyright is 2015; site content may not be fully current but reservation system appears active
OSM has no phone number; website lists 250-756-0404 and toll-free 1-866-756-0404
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established campground near Nanaimo on a common Vancouver Island touring route. Accepts reservations and is close to urban amenities, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address available: stay@brannenlake.com. Toll-free number: 1-866-756-0404. Pets allowed on leash. Security gate locked overnight.

wow_evidence: third-generation family-run campground on Brannen Lake with 130+ forested sites and a private beach
